title: The daily tape · 31 August 2026
description: Daily tape · 31 Aug 2026. Country signals and sourced silicon prints. Labeled terms only — no invented 7-day moves.
og_kicker: Country conversion signals and sourced silicon prints.
lede: SK hynix broke ground Thursday on the first US next-generation HBM packaging base in West Lafayette: over $4 billion, cleanroom by October 2028, mass production in H2 2029, Korea wafers packaged in Indiana. In Texas, PUCT granted Oncor 765-kV CCN amendments Friday and tabled Howard–Solstice (59336) past today’s statutory deadline — no Interchange order located this morning, so those votes stay off Wire. The Silicon Tape did not tick — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69, 69 confirms.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: SK hynix, 27 Aug groundbreaking at Purdue / West Lafayette: first US HBM advanced-packaging base, >$4B, cleanroom by Oct 2028, next-gen HBM mass production H2 2029, ~1,000 facility jobs. Korea wafers packaged and tested in Indiana for US customers. Prior Commerce CHIPS award (Dec 2024) up to $458M grants + $500M loans is background, not restated in the 28 Aug newsroom note. Source: SK hynix Newsroom.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.note: Keelung District Prosecutors, 24 Aug: eight people indicted (Nvidia Taiwan distribution manager, two Super Micro Taiwan sales managers, plus distributors/traders) for breach of trust and forgery on 130 Supermicro B300 servers. CNA: 74 reached Chinese buyers (direct / Indonesia / Japan–Hong Kong); 56 seized in Taiwan; >$21.2M illicit proceeds. Flying Tiger principal still wanted. Source: CNA / Focus Taiwan.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: PUCT Open Meeting 28 Aug: Tribune reports unanimous approval of two Oncor 765-kV CCN amendments and a table of Howard–Solstice (Docket 59336). KUT identifies the northern path as ~400 miles Glen Rose to Reeves County, with easements now allowed. Statutory CCN deadline on 59336 was 31 Aug; no Interchange order PDF located this morning, so neither the grant nor the table is Wire. Source: Texas Tribune / KUT.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Botetourt County, 28 Aug: Google received a Land Disturbance Permit to begin phased grading on its 312-acre Greenfield campus (three ~300k sq ft buildings). Google has not disclosed campus MW; Rocky Forge wind (79.3 MW) will not cover the load. Named dirt-moving, not a MW FID — not Wire. Source: WSLS / Botetourt County.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Georgia Power, 26 Aug: 3,200 MW OpenAI Effingham contract on the PSC staff path; OpenAI pays full infrastructure cost; up to 1,000 MW flexible DR. Public summary still due. Source: Georgia Power / Southern Company.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: George Town Council, 25 Aug: 6–1 approval of Firmus 288 MW at Bell Bay. 14-day TASCAT appeal window runs into early September. Source: ABC News.

countries.name: China
countries.note: NVIDIA Q2 FY27 (26 Aug): Data Center $89.0B. Hopper China <1% of DC revenue. Q3 $108.0B ±2% assumes no China DC compute. Source: NVIDIA Newsroom / SEC EX-99.2.
